Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], '''the nest''' was used as base of operations by the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]]. The [[King/Legends|king]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]], was hidden in the nest from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which had [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|invaded the planet]]. The nest was later attacked by a [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|droid gunship]] and several [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]].
